purpose: Separate browser relay transport latency from same-account privacy eligibility.

environment.method: One helper and one sender used a fresh random valid pool binding for each sample. No secret keys, account addresses, private addresses, payloads, XDR, or transaction hashes were retained.

decision: Keep Nostr discovery, add truthful connection readiness and automatic WebSocket reconnection, and explain same-account ineligibility without weakening the privacy boundary. Do not add WebRTC as a second discovery transport.
limitations: This is a four-sample controlled desktop diagnostic, not production p50/p95 evidence.
At least one configured public relay was connected at the start of each helper sample.
The experiment measured request-to-quote behavior, not proof generation or Stellar submission.
